lines.text: Jairus, a synagogue leader, begs Jesus to come to his house because his only daughter, about twelve, is dying.
A woman bleeding for twelve years spent all her money on physicians, then touched the fringe of Jesus' cloak.
When Jesus asks who touched Him, Peter points to the crowd, and Jesus says power has gone out from Him.
The woman comes trembling and explains herself before everyone, and Jesus tells her that her courage has healed her.
Jesus lets only Peter, John, Andrew and the girl's parents inside, takes her hand, and says, "Child, get up!"
